propositions: The Git version floor gate step fails every in-flight change branched before c433663721 merged, regardless of whether the change touches Git version logic, because the step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the patchset tree but Gerrit's Verified lane runs the workflow definition from the target branch.

When .github/git-version-floor.txt is absent from a pre-gate patchset tree, the gate hard-fails with '::error::missing <floorfile>' instead of skipping, violating the documented Definition-vs-tree skew guard convention already applied to adjacent steps.
The root cause is tree-skew: the patchset tree lacks the floor file (not yet merged), while the workflow definition (from main) has the gate step that requires the file to exist.

The fix applies the established if-present guard pattern keyed on .github/git-version-floor.txt, causing the gate to skip with a diagnostic naming the real remedy (rebase/post-merge re-enforcement) when the file is absent, rather than failing with a message that sends authors hunting for a file they never touched.
